args.title: Fix weekly scheduled export skipping the first week when created on scheduled day
args.body:
File: src/worker/scheduler.ts

Ensure weekly scheduled exports created on their scheduled day but later than the initial check time or execution window are handled correctly so that the first week's export is sent on creation day rather than being skipped until the following week.
